🔥 The fire settles. Elias has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Javier asks "Say that again — slower." Henry says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
